chars.AMMAR: AMMAR: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and a white cook apron.
chars.HAMMAD: HAMMAD: a young man wearing a red-and-black checkered flannel shirt, black tracksuit trousers and a thin black moustache drawn on his white face.
chars.SOUKAINA: SOUKAINA: a young woman wearing a lilac hijab, a long beige trench coat and a small pink handbag.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small busy Moroccan lobia (bean stew) snack shop in Derb Sultan, Casablanca, with steaming pots, clay bowls of beans, bread baskets and tiled counter. HAMMAD stands behind the counter with arms crossed, sulking and glaring sideways, while AMMAR next to him holds a ladle and stares at him confused. Clear tension between them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a small modest Casablanca rented apartment room with two thin mattresses on the floor and a Moroccan blanket. HAMMAD stomps in angrily and slams the door, puffing his cheeks, while AMMAR sitting on a mattress jumps in surprise.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In the small bathroom corner of a small modest Casablanca rented apartment room with two thin mattresses on the floor and a Moroccan blanket. HAMMAD crouches over a plastic bucket washing his own clothes alone with a grumpy face, while AMMAR leans in the doorway watching him puzzled.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a small modest Casablanca rented apartment room with two thin mattresses on the floor and a Moroccan blanket at evening. AMMAR, worried, puts a hand toward HAMMAD and asks him what is wrong; HAMMAD turns his face away avoiding eye contact.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a small modest Casablanca rented apartment room with two thin mattresses on the floor and a Moroccan blanket. HAMMAD sits alone on his mattress hunched over, staring secretly at his phone with a guilty sneaky look, phone screen turned away from the viewer.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small busy Moroccan lobia (bean stew) snack shop in Derb Sultan, Casablanca, with steaming pots, clay bowls of beans, bread baskets and tiled counter. AMMAR serves a bowl of beans at the counter with a tired uneasy face, while in the background HAMMAD silently chops onions and avoids looking at him.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small busy Moroccan lobia (bean stew) snack shop in Derb Sultan, Casablanca, with steaming pots, clay bowls of beans, bread baskets and tiled counter in the morning. SOUKAINA sits at a small table eating beans with bread; behind the counter HAMMAD leans on his elbows staring at her with a dreamy smitten smile, while AMMAR in the far background is busy at the pots and does not notice.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night in a small modest Casablanca rented apartment room with two thin mattresses on the floor and a Moroccan blanket. AMMAR lies on his mattress in the dark lit only by his phone, holding the phone to his ear, eyes wide open in shock as if hearing a big secret.
